title: SessionState
description: Shared protocol state broadcast from Leader to all Followers.

leader_ip.description: IPv4 address of the leader device.

current_song_id.description: Active song identifier or null if none loaded.

next_event_timestamp.description: Absolute monotonic nanosecond timestamp on the leader clock when the next musical event (e.g. beat 1) must occur.

bpm.description: Current tempo in beats per minute.
